Text.Text: The enclave can reclaim the halls. Teach with more restraint than my former students did. You've finished my Epicenter trials. I have no further work for you here.
These trials require rank 50 in Lightsaber. Reach it and return. Control your footing before you test it under pressure.

My students barred the trial halls and kept teaching the storm drills without restraint. Recover their slate so I can start putting that right. Defeat six Saber Storm Adepts in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave. I'll give you the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Epicenter.

Here's the Dantooine Jedi Enclave Trial Halls Key. Use 'Jedi Enclave Trial Halls' in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Library. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Saber Storm Adepts, then return with the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate.

Saber Storm is the name of the school you're confronting. The technique these trials qualify you to learn is Epicenter. Recovering its records and defeating its master will show me you're ready for that training.

Use 'Jedi Enclave Trial Halls' in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Library. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Saber Storm Adepts in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave.

Mine, once. Students who loved the fury and skipped the footwork. Six of them hold the outer ring, and they fight like the form itself: fast, relentless, no respect for a yield. Don't offer one. They stopped honoring the tap-out months ago.
Defeat six Saber Storm Adepts in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave.
You've defeated six Saber Storm Adepts. Let me see the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate.
The training record is back. We can see what went wrong. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are using the enclave's focus shard in their unsupervised drills. Take it back. Defeat five Saber Storm Specialists in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Defeat five Saber Storm Specialists to secure the Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard, then return to me.

Control. Adepts flail; specialists place every cut. Five of them rotating as one line is a wall of edges, and they will trade you strike for strike without tiring, because the shard drives the drill array and the array never calls rest.

A cut of kyber tuned to a saber's hum. In the trial array it sets tempo, like a metronome that argues back. We used it to teach rhythm. They use it to erase the pause where judgment lives. Pull it, and the middle ring goes quiet.

Don't chase. Five blades want you overextended, and the storm punishes a planted foot worst of all. Move through them, not at them. Also, drink water before you go in. Nobody thinks of it and everybody regrets it.
Defeat five Saber Storm Specialists in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave.
You've defeated five Saber Storm Specialists. Let me see the Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard.
That equipment no longer serves their drills. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden keeps the trial halls closed to the enclave. Recover his fractured sigil and end his watch. Defeat the Saber Storm Warden in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Saber Storm Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Saber Storm Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

It cracked the day she sealed the halls. A trial sigil answers to the enclave council, and it split rather than answer to her. She wears it anyway. Broken authority still has the shape of authority, if nobody looks too closely.

My finest student. She passed every drill I set before I finished setting it. When the storm took the others, she didn't rage like the adepts or calculate like the specialists. She simply closed the third door and said the form deserved better students than the Order sends. She isn't wrong about everything. Stop her anyway.

Defeat the Saber Storm Warden in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Saber Storm Warden. Let me see the Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil.
The warden's watch is over. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four senior students still hold the council's authority to teach. Recover their trial chit. Defeat four members of the Saber Storm Inner Circle in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Storm Council Trial Chit; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Defeat four members of the Saber Storm Inner Circle to secure the Saber Storm Council Trial Chit, then return to me.

A slug of bronzium stamped by the enclave council, and it means this form may be passed on. It is the difference between a discipline and a hazard. While the inner circle holds it, they may teach whoever survives long enough to learn. That is how the storm spread through these halls in the first place.

Like examiners. They test you one at a time until they find the flaw, then all four press it at once. Everyone has the flaw, mind you. You. Me. The trick is knowing yours and folding it behind your guard before they finish the survey.

I did. Proudest work I ever ruined. An examiner must out-fence anyone she grades, so I built four of the best and never asked what happens when examiners stop answering to anyone. Now you're the answer. Sorry about that.

Defeat four members of the Saber Storm Inner Circle in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave Trial Halls. Their defeat secures the Saber Storm Council Trial Chit; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave.
You've defeated four members of the Saber Storm Inner Circle. Let me see the Saber Storm Council Trial Chit.
Their instructors no longer hold the authority to teach. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the final trial. Defeat him in the Saber Trial Chamber and end the school's hold on the halls. Defeat the Saber Storm Master in Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Saber Storm Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

My first student, and my sparring partner every dawn for eleven years. He mastered the storm before anyone had named it, and it never let him go. He didn't seal these halls out of malice. He sealed them because he believes the form should end with him. Prove it ends with you instead.

Every storm the rest of us make has a center, a still point where the duelist actually lives. Find it and you've found the man. His has none. He is offense with nothing at the middle, and that is the tragedy and the technique both. Three of you means three centers. He cannot erase what he does not have.

Then I chalk the ring, take down the blade hanging on that wall, and finish my own failed lesson at last. But I've watched your footwork since the day I first corrected it, and I'm not oiling that hilt yet. When it gets loud in there, fall back on the drills. They live in your feet now.

Defeat the Saber Storm Master in Dantooine, Saber Trial Chamber. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Jedi Enclave; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Saber Storm Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The enclave can reclaim the halls. Teach with more restraint than my former students did. You've earned the right to train Epicenter. Your final payment is ready.
Walk me through the drill again.
I'll defeat six Saber Storm Adepts.
How does this school relate to Epicenter?
How do I get into the trial halls?
Who are these adepts?
Not yet. My form isn't ready.
Here's the Saber Storm Enclave Trial Slate.
Go back. I had another question.
I'll defeat five Saber Storm Specialists.
What makes the specialists different?
What is this focus shard?
Any advice for the middle ring?
Not yet. I need more time on the drills.
Here's the Saber Storm Kyber Focus Shard.
Back up. I'm not done asking.
I'll defeat the Saber Storm Warden.
Would you recommend bringing help?
What happened to the sigil?
Tell me about the warden.
Not until the right blades stand beside me.
Here's the Saber Storm Fractured Trial Sigil.
Let's go over the high ring again.
I'll defeat four members of the Saber Storm Inner Circle.
What is this council chit?
How does the inner circle fight?
You trained them to test students?
Not today. I know my flaw, and it needs work.
Here's the Saber Storm Council Trial Chit.
Say the whole of it once more.
I'll face the Saber Storm Master and report back.
Who is the master?
No eye to the storm. What does that mean for me?
And if the three of us fall?
Not yet. The blades I trust aren't on Dantooine today.
The Saber Storm Master is defeated. Here's my report.
